description: This file implements the LzwDecode filter class for decoding LZW compressed data within a PDF processing library. It provides methods to decode data streams using the LZW algorithm, which is unsupported for encoding in this library.

classes.name: LzwDecode
classes.description: A class that implements the LZW decoding filter as part of PDFsharp's PDF filter mechanisms.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException since encoding is not supported.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes LZW compressed data; raises exception if unsupported flavor encountered.

methods.name: InitializeDictionary
methods.description: Initializes the string table (dictionary) for LZW decoding.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds new sequence entries to the dictionary during decoding.

methods.name: NextCode
methods.description: Retrieves the next code (symbol) from the compressed data stream.
